therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell apoptosis and growth inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: recurrent low-grade and anaplastic supratentorial, infratentorial, and spinal cord ependymoma patients

subgroup_findings: Cohort 1 (≤2 prior chemotherapies): 1/3 participants progression-free at 6 months
Cohort 2 (>2 prior chemotherapies): 0/1 participants progression-free at 6 months
No participants achieved complete or partial response
safety_signals: Grade 1 toxicities: 35 events in Cohort 1, 13 events in Cohort 2
Grade 2 toxicities: 24 events in Cohort 1, 5 events in Cohort 2
Grade 3 toxicities: 6 events in Cohort 1, 0 events in Cohort 2
Serious adverse event: headache in 1 participant
results.dose_information: 0.8mg/m² intravenous on days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle, planned for 24 cycles total
